title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E21 — Tagg Oakley, Sheriff
A contractor agrees to deliver government gunpowder to Geronimo.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E22 — The Waco Kid
Annie's childhood sweetheart has become an outlaw, the Waco Kid.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E23 — The Saga of Clement O'Toole
A clumsy fortune-hunter doubles for a notorious gunfighter.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E03 — Gunplay
An outlaw (Myron Healey) poses as a marshal in an attempt to free his brother from jail. With Paul McGuire, Gail Davis.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E04 — The Dude Stagecoach
Annie (Gail Davis) challenges a mine owner's spoiled rich daughter (Maura Murphy) to a race. With Tom London.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E06 — Annie Calls Her Shots
After being framed and serving seven years in prison, a bitter man (Harry Lauter) returns to town. With Gail Davis.

title: Jesse James Rides Again
description: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: Loser's End
description: A cowboy (Jack Perrin) and his sidekick (Frank Rice) pursue a gang of smugglers and save a Mexican dancer (Tina Menard).

title: Range War
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and sidekick Lucky (Russell Hayden) help a railroad man (Matt Moore) thwart a land baron.

title: Fighting Caravans
description: A French girl (Lily Damita) joins a wagon train from Missouri led by two scouts and their young partner (Gary Cooper).

title: Land of Hunted Men
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, Dennis Moore, Max Terhune) track outlaws to their hide-out.

title: The Painted Desert
description: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

title: Fugitive of the Plains
description: Billy the Kid (Buster Crabbe) stages a shootout with outlaws who have transformed an innocent young lady into a wanted desperado.

title: Revenge of the Virgins
description: When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

title: Broadway to Cheyenne
description: A New York police officer, shot and wounded by a gangster, travels to Cheyenne, Wyo., to recuperate at his family's ranch, and is surprised to find a bootlegger from New York running a speakeasy there.

title: Raiders of the Border
description: U.S. marshals (Johnny Mack Brown, Raymond Hatton) catch rustlers swapping cattle for Mexican jewels.

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E16 — Mysterious Decoy
Hooded vigilantes are involved in a boundary dispute.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E17 — Ridge of Ghosts
A gold watch is the only clue to a string of murders.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E18 — Hang the Jury
The agents investigate a hanging judge in Oklahoma for the state authorities.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E22 — Rawhiders
Agents go to Washington territory to investigate an imposter posing as a U.S. Secret Service agent.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E12 — Honeymoon Hotel
Uncle Joe becomes a justice of the peace with hopes of attracting honeymooners.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E13 — A Night at the Hooterville Hilton
A brochure for the Shady Rest Hotel of the future is prematurely distributed.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E14 — Cannonball Christmas
Homer plans to keep the Cannonball from making its Christmas caroling tour.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E15 — Herby Gets Drafted
Herby Bates, who is sweet on Billie Jo, won't be seeing much more of her, he has just been drafted.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E19 — Eyes of Texas
Even though Judge Roy Bean temporarily loses his eyesight, he's still able to uncover a plot to steal Indian land.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E02 — Family Ties
In Family Ties, Judge Bean comes to the aid of the Peralta family as unscrupulous real estate agents try to force them off their land. They've learned that a railroad will need the property, and they intend to make an undeserved profit.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E12 — The Fugitive
Thieves posing as newspapermen attempt to blackmail a local rancher to steal his land and property.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E21 — The Hidden Truth
Judge Bean discovers that a young vagabond he jailed for a minor offense might be involved in a major unsolved gold heist.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E32 — The Hypnotist
Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, a con involving the Haunted Hills draws Judge Roy's attention.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E09 — Judge Declares a Holiday
The judge meets up with a con man who comes to towns and arranges horse races; he then skips town with the receipts and all the money that was bet.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Judge's Dilemma
A gang plans to take over the town by getting Judge Bean to resign over false misconduct charges.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Katcina Doll
Shorts and Hurley hold a doll hostage that brings good luck to a Mexican village.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Ghost Town Gold
description: The Three Mesquiteers set out to trap outlaws who have robbed a bank and stashed the loot in an abandoned village.

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: Stagecoach to Denver
description: Red Ryder uncovers a land-grabbing scheme engineered by a supposedly respected member of the community.

title: A Lust to Kill
description: A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

title: Law of the Pampas
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekick (Russell Hayden) head for South America to deliver cattle.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E21 — Pancho Held Hostage
Cisco and Pancho capture a notorious bank robber after falling for a trap set by the criminal's sister.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E22 — Freight Line Feud
Cisco and Pancho attempt to convince a freighting company owner that her competitor did not steal from her wagons.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E23 — Phony Sheriff
A phony sheriff is part of a rustling scheme.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E24 — Uncle Disinherits Niece
Cisco and Pancho discover the shady motives of a lawyer hired to change a rancher's will.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E13 — Joaquin Murietta
The 1850s California gold fields are home to notorious bandit Joaquin Murietta; Matt and Frankie arrive to track him down, but he kidnaps Frankie; Matt and Captain Love trail Murietta to the bitter end.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E14 — Tiburcio Vasquez
Tiburcio Vasquez vows vengeance against Anglos after his sister Dolores is killed; Matt and Frankie try to stop his years of terror in Southern California after a railroad agent is killed with the help of a local priest.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E15 — Chief Crazy Horse
Matt enlists the aid of Dakota chiefs to bring in Crazy Horse.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E16 — Black Bart
The man behind a string of stagecoach robberies has remained out of reach of company detectives Matt and Frankie, but reinforcements from the city help to crack the case.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E26 — The Avenger
A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E29 — Bitter Water
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E30 — Feet of Clay
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E31 — Dark Star
Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

title: Yodelin' Kid From Pine Ridge
description: A singing cowboy rides to the rescue when a feud erupts between cattlemen and turpentine manufacturers.

title: Frontier Justice
description: A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

title: Buffalo Stampede
description: Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan must track down and outsmart a gang of white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians to save the woman he loves.

title: Captain Apache
description: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: Lost Canyon
description: After Johnny is accused of robbing a bank, he runs into the hills. When his friend Hopalong Cassidy hears what happened, Hopalong sets out to find the real bad guys.

title: The Kansan
description: The new marshal (Richard Dix) of a Kansas town cracks down on his sponsor, a greedy banker (Albert Dekker).

title: Bulldog Courage
description: A young man, out to avenge his father's murder, prompts speedy action from the law.

title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
description: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Hellgate
description: After the Civil War, ranch owner Gil Hanley helps a stranger in desperate need of medical attention. Soon he is questioned by Union soldiers about the stranger, who turns out to be an ex-Confederate soldier.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E26 — Water Rights
A crooked stagecoach driver accuses Cisco and Pancho of stealing $50,000 from him.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E01 — Boomerang
A prominent investment broker is captured after scheming to have two of his men impersonate Cisco and Pancho at a bank hold-up.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E04 — Big Switch
A clever criminal hopes to rob a wealthy rancher, but Cisco and Pancho bring the man to justice.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E05 — Convict Story
An escaped convict is nearly murdered while trying to prove that he did not commit a crime.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E17 — Henry Plummer
Elected as mayor, an outlaw deputizes members of his gang.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E18 — Bill Longley
A killer escapes from prison and tries to reunite with his girlfriend.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E19 — Harry Tracy
Harry Tracy terrorized America's northwest at the end of the 19th century; Matt and a posse have cornered the outlaw.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E20 — The Wild Bunch of Wyoming
Matt and Frankie follow Butch Cassidy to South America.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E02 — The Threat
Hawkeye and Chingachgook find a group of new settlers, trapped in the Huron's territory.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E03 — Franklin Story
After several people are murdered Hawkeye seeks the help of his friend Benjamin Franklin.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E04 — The Wild One
A young Indian Doctor attempts to practice medicine while the townspeople practice intolerance.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E05 — Delaware Hoax
The Delaware tribe, friends of Chingachgook, are framed for a murder they didn't commit.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E06 — The Coward
Tom and his father are attacked by Hurons; Tom runs away in fear leaving his wounded father behind.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E07 — The Ethan Allen Story
Ethan Allen and the Green Mountain Boys are at war with the ruthless tax collectors, a bunch of outlaws, more Robin Hood than the Dalton gang; when the authorities start to pin their misdeeds on them, Hawkeye must sort it out.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E08 — The Witch
Someone is going to a lot of trouble to convince the townspeople that a witch has cursed them.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E09 — The Medicine Man
Hawkeye and Chingachgook find Wenatchgo, an old and respected medicine man, wandering in the forest; they discover that the elderly man has been driven out of the tribe by a younger and ambitious rival.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

title: Home in Oklahoma
description: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: Mohawk
description: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.
